s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 200ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 3 sliced spring onions. Drop teaspoons into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Serve hot with 60g butter beaten with 2 tbsp honey.

Grill 16 baguette slices until charred at the edges and rub each with a cut garlic clove. Dice 4 ripe tomatoes and dress with torn basil, salt and 2 tbsp good olive oil. Spoon on just before serving so the toasts stay crisp.

m.how: Brown 4 Italian sausages, skins off and crumbled. Add 1 sliced fennel bulb and 2 garlic cloves and cook 8 minutes. Deglaze with 125ml white wine, add 150ml cream, and toss with 500g cooked rigatoni and 60g grated parmesan.

w.how: Roll a sheet of shortcrust pastry into a rough circle. Toss 4 sliced apples with 60g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon and pile in the middle. Fold the edges up by hand, pleating as you go, and bake at 200C for 40 minutes until golden.

d.note: Molly's studio, late at night at the pottery wheel
d.how: Pour 750ml pinot noir into a saucepan with 2 strips orange peel, the juice of 1 orange, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 star anise, 4 cloves and 3 tbsp honey. Warm over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and add a thin orange slice to each.
